=== hive --help ===
Usage: hive COMMAND

Hive - Multi-agent worktree management CLI.                                                         

Manage AI coding agents and git worktrees for parallel development.

╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ completion      Generate shell completion script.                                                │
│ config          Manage hive configuration.                                                       │
│ diff            Show unified diff of all agent worktrees against main branch.                    │
│ doctor          Check hive's environment and measure startup and hot-path timings.               │
│ handoff         Manage branch handoff notes.                                                     │
│ merge-preview   Preview potential merge conflicts between agent branches.                        │
│ rebase-check    Check if agent worktrees need rebasing against default branch.                   │
│ run             Run AI coding agent in current directory.                                        │
│ status          Display status of all agent worktrees.                                           │
│ task            Manage agent tasks.                                                              │
│ wt              Manage git worktrees for multi-agent development.                                │
│ zellij          Open Zellij with AI agent layout.                                                │
│ --help (-h)     Display this message and exit.                                                   │
│ --version (-V)  Display application version.                                                     │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive run --help ===
Usage: hive run [ARGS]

Run AI coding agent in current directory.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ AGENT --agent -a                     Specific agent to use (overrides auto-detection). [env var: │
│                                      HIVE_AGENT]                                                 │
│ WORKTREE --worktree -w               Run in worktree. Use '-' for selection, or specify branch   │
│                                      name.                                                       │
│ RESUME --resume -r --no-resume -R    Resume most recent conversation (default from config).      │
│ RESTART --restart --no-restart       Auto-restart the agent after it exits. Implies -w=- for     │
│                                      worktree selection. [default: False]                        │
│ RESTART-CONFIRMATION                 Wait for Enter before each restart. Implies --restart.      │
│   --restart-confirmation             [default: False]                                            │
│   --no-restart-confirmation                                                                      │
│ RESTART-DELAY --restart-delay        Delay in seconds between restarts (default: 0). [default:   │
│                                      0]                                                          │
│ SKIP-PERMISSIONS --skip-permissions  Skip permission prompts (default from config).              │
│   -s --no-skip-permissions -S                                                                    │
│ PROFILE --profile -p                 Agent config-dir profile to use. Redirects the agent's      │
│                                      config/history to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hive/profiles//. Omit    │
│                                      (or use 'default') to use the agent's default config dir.   │
│                                      [env var: HIVE_AGENT_PROFILE]                               │
│ AUTO-SELECT --auto-select            Auto-select branch after timeout. Shows picker but          │
│                                      auto-proceeds. Use '-' for repo's default branch. Any key   │
│                                      cancels timer.                                              │
│ ARGS --args --empty-args             Additional arguments to pass to the agent. [default: ()]    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive zellij --help ===
Usage: hive zellij COMMAND [ARGS]

Open Zellij with AI agent layout.

╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ layout-path  Print the resolved path (or name) for a Zellij layout.                              │
│ set-status   Set agent status in pane title.                                                     │
│ set-title    Set custom title suffix in pane title.                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ AGENT --agent -a                Specific agent to use (overrides auto-detection). [env var:      │
│                                 HIVE_AGENT]                                                      │
│ RESTART --restart --no-restart  Auto-restart Zellij after it exits. [default: False]             │
│ RESTART-DELAY --restart-delay   Delay in seconds between restarts (default: 0). [default: 0]     │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive zellij set-status --help ===
Usage: hive zellij set-status [ARGS]

Set agent status in pane title.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ STATUS --status  Agent status (e.g., '[working]').                                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Usage: hive zellij set-title [ARGS]

Set custom title suffix in pane title.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ TITLE --title  Custom title suffix.                                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive zellij layout-path --help ===
Usage: hive zellij layout-path [ARGS]

Print the resolved path (or name) for a Zellij layout.                                              

Useful for running zellij --layout <path> by hand. The bundled "agent" layout renders on every call 
(session.kdl under hive doctor's state dir); "agent-16" and other bundled/path/passthrough values   
are static, as before.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ NAME --name                        Layout name to resolve. Defaults to the configured layout.    │
│ RENDERED --rendered --no-rendered  Explicit request for the rendered 'agent' session file (the   │
│                                    default already renders it; kept for discoverability).        │
│                                    [default: False]                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive wt --help ===
Usage: hive wt COMMAND

Manage git worktrees for multi-agent development.

╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ base    Get the base directory for worktrees.                                                    │
│ cd      Navigate to a worktree.                                                                  │
│ create  Create a new worktree for a branch.                                                      │
│ delete  Delete a worktree.                                                                       │
│ ensure  Interactive agent workflow - select or create worktree.                                  │
│ exec    Execute a command in a worktree.                                                         │
│ exists  Check if a worktree exists.                                                              │
│ list    List all worktrees in branch:path format.                                                │
│ parent  Get the main repository path (parent of all worktrees).                                  │
│ path    Get path for a worktree.                                                                 │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive wt cd --help ===
Usage: hive wt cd [ARGS]

Navigate to a worktree.                                                                             

Outputs the worktree path for shell integration. If BRANCH is not specified, shows interactive      
selection.                                                                                          

Shell integration (fish): function cda set -l path (hive wt cd $argv) and cd $path end

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ BRANCH --branch  Branch name to navigate to.                                                     │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive wt list --help ===
Usage: hive wt list

List all worktrees in branch:path format.
=== hive wt path --help ===
Usage: hive wt path BRANCH

Get path for a worktree.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  BRANCH --branch  Branch name to get path for. [required]                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive wt parent --help ===
Usage: hive wt parent

Get the main repository path (parent of all worktrees).
=== hive wt create --help ===
Usage: hive wt create BRANCH [ARGS]

Create a new worktree for a branch.                                                                 

If the branch doesn't exist, creates it from the default branch.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  BRANCH --branch                 Branch name to create worktree for. [required]                │
│    INSTALL --install --no-install  Install dependencies after creating worktree. [default: True] │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive wt delete --help ===
Usage: hive wt delete BRANCH [ARGS]

Delete a worktree.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  BRANCH --branch              Branch name to delete worktree for. [required]                   │
│    FORCE --force -f --no-force  Force deletion even if worktree has uncommitted changes.         │
│                                 [default: False]                                                 │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive wt exists --help ===
Usage: hive wt exists BRANCH

Check if a worktree exists.                                                                         

Exits with code 0 if exists, 1 if not.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  BRANCH --branch  Branch name to check. [required]                                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive wt base --help ===
Usage: hive wt base

Get the base directory for worktrees.
=== hive wt exec --help ===
Usage: hive wt exec COMMAND [ARGS]

Execute a command in a worktree.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  COMMAND --command -c            Command to execute (shell string). [required]                 │
│    WORKTREE --worktree -w          Run in worktree. Use '-' for selection, or specify branch.    │
│    RESTART --restart --no-restart  Auto-restart after exit. Implies -w=- for interactive         │
│                                    selection. [default: False]                                   │
│    RESTART-CONFIRMATION            Wait for Enter before each restart. Implies --restart.        │
│      --restart-confirmation        [default: False]                                              │
│      --no-restart-confirmation                                                                   │
│    RESTART-DELAY --restart-delay   Delay in seconds between restarts (default: 0). [default: 0]  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive wt ensure --help ===
Usage: hive wt ensure AGENT-NUM

Interactive agent workflow - select or create worktree.                                             

For agent 1, always uses main repo. For other agents, shows interactive selection with:             

 • Fuzzy search through worktrees and branches                                                      
 • Option to create new branches (ESC)                                                              
 • Option to delete worktrees

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  AGENT-NUM --agent-num  Agent number. [required]                                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Usage: hive completion SHELL [ARGS]

Generate shell completion script.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  SHELL --shell                   Shell type to generate completion for. [choices: bash, zsh,   │
│                                    fish] [required]                                              │
│    INSTALL --install --no-install  Install completion script to appropriate location. [default:  │
│                                    False]                                                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive config --help ===
Usage: hive config COMMAND

Manage hive configuration.

╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ bootstrap  Create a new config file with documented options.                                     │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive config bootstrap --help ===
Usage: hive config bootstrap [OPTIONS] [ARGS]

Create a new config file with documented options.                                                   

Without FILE argument, prints the bootstrap config to stdout (pipe to a file or use with -o to      
save).                                                                                              

With FILE argument, creates a new configuration file at that path with all options commented out and
documented.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ FILE --file                Path where to create the config file.                                 │
│ --force -f --no-force      Overwrite existing file. [default: False]                             │
│ --current -c --no-current  Use current effective config instead of defaults. [default: False]    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive status --help ===
Usage: hive status [ARGS]

Display status of all agent worktrees.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ WATCH --watch -w --no-watch        Watch mode with interactive selection. Press Enter to select  │
│                                    worktree. [default: False]                                    │
│ COMPACT --compact -c --no-compact  Use single-line-per-agent compact format. [default: False]    │
│ INTERACTIVE --interactive -i       One-shot interactive selection. Outputs path for shell cd.    │
│   --no-interactive                 [default: False]                                              │
│ INTERVAL --interval                Seconds between refreshes in watch mode. [default: 5.0]       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive task --help ===
Usage: hive task COMMAND [ARGS]

Manage agent tasks.

╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ clear  Clear task for an agent.                                                                  │
│ edit   Edit task in $EDITOR.                                                                     │
│ set    Set task for an agent.                                                                    │
│ show   Show task(s).                                                                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ WATCH --watch -w --no-watch  Live board, repainted only when a task changes. q quits. [default:  │
│                              False]                                                              │
│ INTERVAL --interval          Seconds between refreshes in watch mode. [default: 5.0]             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive task show --help ===
Usage: hive task show [ARGS]

Show task(s).                                                                                       

If AGENT_ID is specified, shows task for that agent. Otherwise, shows all tasks.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ AGENT-ID --agent-id  Agent identifier.                                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

│      --empty-task-content                                                                        │

=== hive handoff --help ===
Usage: hive handoff COMMAND

Manage branch handoff notes.

╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ clean   Remove handoff files for branches that no longer exist.                                  │
│ clear   Clear handoff for a branch.                                                              │
│ create  Create or update a handoff for a branch.                                                 │
│ edit    Edit handoff in $EDITOR.                                                                 │
│ list    List all handoff files.                                                                  │
│ path    Get the path to a handoff file.                                                          │
│ show    Show handoff for a branch.                                                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive handoff list --help ===
Usage: hive handoff list [ARGS]

List all handoff files.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ ALL --all -a --no-all  Show all handoffs including empty ones. [default: False]                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive handoff show --help ===
Usage: hive handoff show [ARGS]

Show handoff for a branch.                                                                          

If BRANCH is not specified, shows handoff for current branch.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ BRANCH --branch  Branch name to show handoff for.                                                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive handoff create --help ===
Usage: hive handoff create [ARGS]

Create or update a handoff for a branch.                                                            

If BRANCH is not specified, uses current branch. If MESSAGE is provided, uses it as the summary.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ BRANCH --branch                    Branch name to create handoff for.                            │
│ MESSAGE --message --empty-message  Handoff message/summary. [default: ()]                        │
│ NO-COMMIT --no-commit              Don't prompt to commit uncommitted changes. [default: False]  │
│   --no-no-commit                                                                                 │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive handoff edit --help ===
Usage: hive handoff edit [ARGS]

Edit handoff in $EDITOR.                                                                            

If BRANCH is not specified, edits handoff for current branch. Creates a template if no handoff      
exists.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ BRANCH --branch  Branch name to edit handoff for.                                                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive handoff clear --help ===
Usage: hive handoff clear [ARGS]

Clear handoff for a branch.                                                                         

Clears the content but keeps the file (for symlink integrity).

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ BRANCH --branch  Branch name to clear handoff for.                                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive handoff clean --help ===
Usage: hive handoff clean [ARGS]

Remove handoff files for branches that no longer exist.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ DRY-RUN --dry-run -n --no-dry-run  Show what would be removed without removing. [default: False] │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive handoff path --help ===
Usage: hive handoff path [ARGS]

Get the path to a handoff file.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ BRANCH --branch  Branch name to get handoff path for.                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Usage: hive diff [ARGS]

Show unified diff of all agent worktrees against main branch.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ STAT --stat -s --no-stat     Show diffstat instead of full diff. [default: False]                │
│ FILES --files -f --no-files  Show only changed file names. [default: False]                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Usage: hive rebase-check [ARGS]

Check if agent worktrees need rebasing against default branch.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ FETCH --fetch -f --no-fetch  Fetch from origin before checking. [default: False]                 │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive merge-preview --help ===
Usage: hive merge-preview [ARGS]

Preview potential merge conflicts between agent branches.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ AGENT-ID --agent-id          Agent identifier to preview merge for.                              │
│ WATCH --watch -w --no-watch  Live board, repainted only when something changes. q quits.         │
│                              [default: False]                                                    │
│ INTERVAL --interval          Seconds between refreshes in watch mode. [default: 5.0]             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
=== hive doctor --help ===
Usage: hive doctor [ARGS]

Check hive's environment and measure startup and hot-path timings.

╭─ Parameters ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ TIMING --timing --no-timing  Time each startup phase (import, config, worktree list, status      │
│                              collect) and count the commands it spawns. [default: False]         │
